events.detail: The bug is localized in `DatePickerField`: clearing currently only stores the mask placeholder and never clears the parent’s `selected` value; blur then unconditionally discards the transient input and falls back to that stale selection. I’m going to track “cleared” separately from ordinary invalid text so blur can clear the selection only for the former.
